1427.name: Default Directory
1427.note: NI: 'Returns the path to the default directory. The default directory is the directory in which LabVIEW automatically stores information unless you specify otherwise.' labviewwiki 'LabVIEW configuration file/Paths' (https://labviewwiki.org/wiki/LabVIEW_configuration_file/Paths), key defaultdir, 'Default Directory': default is the installed LabVIEW folder on Windows/Mac and the user home folder on Linux. A port has no LabVIEW install folder, so the maintainer chose LabVIEW's Linux default (the user home folder) on every OS (decision 2026-11-18).
